title: Magnetic field magnitude

title: Changed electric field

title: Initial velocity

title: Third entry determination
description: Essential: Correctly concludes that the particle will not enter the electric field for a third time from point P in part (3).

title: Work-energy application

title: Lorentz force geometry
description: Important: Uses the Lorentz force as centripetal force (qvB = mv²/R) and solves for trajectory radii using geometric constraints in the magnetic field region.

title: Projectile motion kinematics

title: Sign or direction error

title: Unit or root inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Makes algebraic errors in solving simultaneous equations, resulting in incorrect numerical factors or dimensional inconsistencies in final expressions.

title: Alternative approach check
